about.title: Z&O Optics Center
about.subtitle: Medical precision & modern elegance in one place
about.body: At Z & O Optics, we don't just offer you an eye exam — we offer a complete optical experience that blends medical precision with modern elegance. We are a specialized center and official agents for the most renowned international brands in optical glasses, sunglasses and contact lenses. Our team of specialist optometrists uses the latest equipment to ensure measurement accuracy and reliable results. We put you first — from exam precision, through authentic product quality, to after-sales service that guarantees your complete satisfaction.
about.mission: To give every client clearer vision and finer style through a complete, trusted optical service.
about.vision: To be Iraq's leading optics destination in medical precision, authenticity and elegance.
